claims.text: The FDA tapentadol label says opioids with alcohol may cause profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma, and death.
claims.quote: Concomitant use of opioids with benzodiazepines or other central nervous system (CNS) depressants, including alcohol, may result in profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma, and death.

headline.text: The FDA tapentadol label warns of profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma, and death with alcohol.

reported.text: The boxed warning describes severe central nervous system effects when opioids, including tapentadol, are combined with alcohol.
